# Variety VIP+

> > Premium entertainment industry analysis covering streaming economics, generative AI impact, and media technology trends.

Variety VIP+ provides data-driven insights and strategic analysis for entertainment professionals navigating the streaming wars, AI disruption, and evolving content production landscape. Features original research, consumer surveys, and expert commentary from industry analysts.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI in entertainment
- Streaming economics and Peak TV
- Netflix and SVOD platforms
- CTV advertising and privacy
- AI regulation and copyright
- Content spending strategies
- Film and video production tools
- Viewership data and analytics
- Celebrity deepfakes and NIL rights
- SAG-AFTRA and labor issues
- Smart TV and in-vehicle entertainment
- VR/AR content consumption
- Gaming industry economics
- Consumer behavior surveys

## Streaming Industry & Economics

- [Streaming Companies Overspent on Peak TV Original Series](https://variety.com/vip/streamers-overspent-original-content-peak-tv-1235945997): Analysis of Netflix and streamers' overspending on Peak TV content
- [How Paramount+ and Peacock Could Succeed in Streaming After All](https://variety.com/vip/how-paramount-peacock-could-succeed-in-streaming-1235789935): Strategic analysis of Paramount+ and Peacock streaming success paths
- [Paramount+-Peacock Bundle Has Potential: Survey](https://variety.com/vip/paramount-peacock-bundle-streaming-survey-1235962030): Consumer survey on Paramount+-Peacock bundle amid Skydance acquisition
- [Mogul Memo: How Ted Sarandos Can Save Hollywood](https://variety.com/vip/ted-sarandos-netflix-strike-hollywood-1235677096): Andrew Wallenstein on Ted Sarandos' role in Hollywood labor disputes
- [Why Walmart Is Becoming a Streaming Power Player](https://variety.com/vip/walmart-becoming-streaming-power-player-1236209428): Walmart's Vizio acquisition and Walmart+ challenge Amazon Prime streaming
